lines.text: Sticky notes on the monitor. A spreadsheet nobody fully trusts. Six different tools — and somehow, none of them talk to each other.
This is Linear — fast, and built to stay out of your way. Every issue gets triaged and moving, so the busywork disappears.
Plan the cycle in seconds. Drag an issue into place, and watch the whole sprint shift to match it.
Zoom out, and see exactly where every project really stands — velocity, blockers, progress, all at a glance.
Try it free. No credit card, no setup call — just Linear, ready when you are.

bgm.blob: Linear replaces slow, scattered issue tracking with one fast, focused tool built for software teams.
